# Good Default

Good Default is a searchable catalog and article site for better household defaults: safer materials, practical product swaps, and affiliate-supported recommendations with zero sponsored placements.

## Core Pages

- Home: https://gooddefault.com/
- Catalog: https://gooddefault.com/catalog/
- Compare Products: https://gooddefault.com/compare/
- Posts Archive: https://gooddefault.com/p/

## Topics

- Non-toxic household products
- PFAS-free cookware, clothing, cleaning, baby gear, tableware, and home goods
- Glass and stainless steel swaps for kitchens and kids
- Personal care ingredient safety
- Practical low-toxin swaps without panic or perfectionism

## Commercial Model

Good Default does not sell sponsored placements. Some product links are affiliate links, including Amazon links.
